_comment: Execution role for the AgentCore Runtime data-quality reviewer (ADR 0002 WS2, Pilot Task 14). Policy-as-data like every other role in this repo (design.md 10.1, config/iam-ingestion-role.json). Apply with: python scripts/apply_iam.py --config config/iam-reviewer-runtime-role.json. This role is the IAM expression of Req 13.8 -- the reviewer's isolation is not a promise in a prompt, it is the set of actions this role does NOT grant.
_naming: The -dev suffix follows config/iam-ingestion-role.json: generated resources coexist with manually created ones during the migration to IaC.
description: Execution role for the isolated AgentCore Runtime data-quality reviewer.
_isolation_note: SEPARATE from the orchestrator and ingestion roles ON PURPOSE (Req 11.9, 13.8). The reviewer reads a snapshot pushed into a single invocation and calls one model. It CANNOT read DynamoDB (not the products table, not history, not idempotency), CANNOT touch S3, CANNOT write anything, and has no shopper-path permission. A defect in the reviewer cannot express itself as a data read or a write, because the actions are not on this role. That absence is the whole security argument.

Statement._comment: The AgentCore Runtime service assumes this role to run the microVM. Trusts the AgentCore service principal, NOT lambda.amazonaws.com -- this is not a Lambda.

The ONE thing the reviewer does: call the model, through the numbered Guardrail. Scoped to the Nova Lite MODEL and its inference profile -- never bedrock:* and never Resource *. THE REGION IS WILDCARDED ON THE FOUNDATION-MODEL ARN ON PURPOSE: the routed id is the `apac.` CROSS-REGION inference profile, which fans a single call out to the underlying foundation model in whichever APAC region has capacity (observed: ap-northeast-1, not just ap-southeast-2). A region-pinned foundation-model ARN denies the call the moment the profile routes elsewhere -- which is exactly what happened on the first live invoke (AccessDenied on ap-northeast-1). The model id stays pinned (amazon.nova-lite-v1:0); only the region floats, and only for the model this reviewer is qualified to use. The guardrail ApplyGuardrail action is included because generation goes through a numbered Guardrail (security.md).

CloudWatch Logs for the Runtime's own log group. The reviewer's logging rule (security.md) is that it records THAT a review ran, never WHAT it reviewed -- no row contents, no findings text. Scoped to the reviewer log group only.
Powertools/X-Ray tracing. Segment writes take no resource, so * is the only expressible form -- identical to the ingestion and orchestrator roles.
